title: 📄 Two papers have been accepted to ACM CIKM 2026 [BKCSA 3] (Short Paper Track)
author: DM Lab
content:
Two research papers from our group have been accepted to **ACM CIKM 2026** (Short Paper Track) [BKCSA 3].

- **PRISM: Reliable LLM Knowledge Distillation from Graph-Context Perspectives for Text-Attributed Graph Learning**  
  *Junghyun Kim, Sobin Jung, David Y. Kang, Sang-Wook Kim*
- **Who Should Teach? Confidence-Aware Dual-Teacher Learning for Few-Shot Node Classification on Text-Attributed Graphs**  
  *Hojin Kim, Sujin Yoon, Sungsu Lim, Dongwon Lee, David Y. Kang*

Congratulations to all authors!

title: 💻 Our lab started a new research project 'CORAL' supported by NRF (한국연구재단)
author: HCI Lab
content:
Our lab started a new research project **"CORAL: Development of Co-Regulation Agent Loop Technology for Daily Rhythm Recovery in Bipolar Disorder"** (CORAL: 양극성 장애 환자의 일상 리듬 회복을 위한 인간-AI 공동조정형 에이전트 루프 기술 개발), supported by the **National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF / 한국연구재단)**.

Congratulations 🎉

title: 🧳 Our lab members attended the 1st Data Intelligence × Human-Computer Interaction Workshop @ UNIST
author: Research Group
content:
Our lab members attended the **1st Data Intelligence × Human-Computer Interaction Workshop** hosted at UNIST.

Researchers and students from CBNU DxH Research Group presented ongoing research topics and participated in active discussions on collaborative intelligence, behavioral sensing, and graph mining algorithms.
